security.item: Fixed unauthenticated page creation via a bare CSRF token.
Fixed missing permission checks on collection rename/publish by ID.
Fixed page/collection creation silently overwriting an existing record.
Replaced the quixlogin cookie-guessing fallback with a signed, time-limited token.

fix.item: Cursor jumping in builder text fields.
Canvas loading overlay hidden behind builder UI.
Page meta description overwritten by menu item.
Local image URLs not resolved to absolute for OG/meta tags.
Twig function name collision with other extensions.
Advanced tab fields (CSS ID/Class, etc.) occasionally empty after cache rebuild.
Schema cache could corrupt under concurrent rebuilds.
A misleading "WebAssetManager is locked" error could mask the real failure and skip logging it.
Debug / Error Logs screen showed no entries even when errors were actually being logged.
Clear Log button did not actually clear the log file.
Page checkout could fail with "Argument userId must be an integer" on some hosts.
License activation rejected valid keys as a mismatch on any site without a manual config override.
Bundled JMedia sub-extensions shipping mismatched version numbers.
"Activate Now" / "License missing" indicators rendered in neutral colors instead of red.
License request/response debug log entries logged at WARNING instead of INFO.

Component language files not installing due to a filename mismatch in the manifest — renamed en-GB.com_quix.ini to com_quix.ini (and same for .sys.ini) to match what ships and what Joomla actually loads.

addition.item: Debug / Error Logs screen for render and builder-load failures.
Detects a builder stuck loading, not just one that throws an error.
Automatic license re-check with actionable admin notices.
Admin notice when JMedia is disabled, linking to Extensions to re-enable it.
License activation/deactivation/check calls now logged for debugging.
Debug / Error Logs screen shows the log file's path on disk.

change.item: Faster builder boot — element icons load in one request instead of dozens.
Faster page loads — static assets served directly instead of via PHP proxy.
Simplified admin toolbar cache controls into one-click clean.
Cache icon now shows a spinner while clearing, instead of no feedback at all.
Revised the "new v2 license system" notice with a clearer message and a Visit License Server button.

fix.item: Fixed cross-domain copy/paste silently failing in Chromium-based browsers: the builder cached a reference to the clipboard frame before it finished loading, so copied elements never reached the shared clipboard and paste could hang.

change.item: Cross-domain copy/paste is now opt-in (Options → Cross-domain Copy/Paste, off by default). The builder no longer loads the getquix.net clipboard frame unless you enable it — this removes the Cloudflare "verify you are human" checkbox some users saw inside the builder.
Copy/paste within the same site now works without the external clipboard frame, using browser storage.

security.item: Fixed an unauthenticated SQL injection in the Joomla Article element.
Fixed a code-execution path via the Raw HTML element (PHP tags in element content are now neutralised).
Fixed a path traversal / arbitrary file read in the Form element submission handler.
Fixed stored cross-site scripting (XSS) through the icon field, including inline SVG.
Fixed the Advanced → CSS ID / Class fields not being sanitised on render (the sanitiser read the wrong data path), which allowed CSS selector and class-attribute breakout on a saved page.
Added an explicit permission check to the admin media manager endpoint.
Stopped reflecting internal error details in frontend AJAX responses.
Updated the bundled JMedia media manager: blocks executable/polyglot uploads (RCE) and remote-URL SSRF, sanitises uploaded SVG, and serves files with hardened headers to close a media-picker XSS.

fix.item: Fixed a fatal error ("Class 'Joomla\Database\ParameterType' not found") in the Joomla Article element on Joomla 3.
Fixed a fatal error on Joomla 6 ("Class 'Joomla\CMS\Filesystem\Folder' not found") when rendering a Quix page — the filesystem classes it used were removed in Joomla 6.
Fixed a fatal error on every page render caused by dead form-encryption setup in the form footer.

change.item: Updating Quix now automatically clears every Quix cache — page/view cache, compiled template (Twig) cache, builder schema cache, and dynamic icon/image caches — so security fixes take effect immediately without a manual cache clear.

security.item: Security release — updating is strongly recommended for all sites.
Fixed an unauthenticated SQL injection in the Joomla Article element.
Fixed a code-execution path via the Raw HTML element (PHP tags in element content are now neutralised).
Fixed a path traversal / arbitrary file read in the Form element submission handler.
Fixed stored cross-site scripting (XSS) through the icon field, including inline SVG.
Added an explicit permission check to the admin media manager endpoint.
Stopped reflecting internal error details in frontend AJAX responses.
Updated the bundled JMedia media manager: blocks executable/polyglot uploads (RCE) and remote-URL SSRF, sanitises uploaded SVG, and serves files with hardened headers to close a media-picker XSS.

fix.item: Fixed images being cropped by an over-eager aspect-ratio/object-fit rule inherited from an updated UIkit base.
Restored the builder loading screen, which had become invisible so the editor appeared to load on a blank page.
Pricing Table: reverted the forced card styling, border and default description that were applied to existing tables, while keeping the new GSAP entrance animations.

security.item: Completed a full security audit of the extension. Updating is strongly recommended.
Hardened all frontend API endpoints with strict permission and access checks.
Fixed input handling and output escaping across elements, modules, and plugins.
Tightened file, URL, and database query handling throughout the component.

fix.item: Improved frontend performance: self-hosted GSAP loaded only when needed, and compressed asset delivery.
Reduced memory usage during page rendering.
Fixed compatibility issues with Joomla 5.3+ and the Atom template on Joomla 5/6.

Fixed builder failing to load all elements when a single element has a broken configuration (surfaced as a "WebAssetManager is locked" error), and made element loading faster by no longer rebuilding the full schema cache on every request.
